import Mathlib
open Filter Real Function
open scoped Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Pugh_exercise_3_1 {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hf : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ |x - y| ^ 2) :
  ∃ c, f = λ _x => c := by
  have h_le : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), |f x - f y| ≤ (x - y) ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      simpa using hf x y
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x y
      let m := (x + y) / 2
      have h1 : |f x - f y| ≤ |f x - f m| + |f m - f y| := by
        have : f x - f y = (f x - f m) + (f m - f y) := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact abs_add_le _ _
      have h2 := ih x m
      have h3 := ih m y
      have hsq1 : (x - m) ^ 2 = (x - y) ^ 2 / 4 := by
        dsimp [m]
        ring
      have hsq2 : (m - y) ^ 2 = (x - y) ^ 2 / 4 := by
        dsimp [m]
        ring
      rw [hsq1] at h2
      rw [hsq2] at h3
      have h_sum : |f x - f m| + |f m - f y| ≤ (x - y) ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
        calc
          |f x - f m| + |f m - f y| ≤ (x - y) ^ 2 / 4 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k + (x - y) ^ 2 / 4 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k :=
            add_le_add h2 h3
          _ = (x - y) ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
            rw [pow_succ]
            ring
      exact h1.trans h_sum
  have h_abs : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ 0 := by
    intro x y
    have h_geom : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h_mul : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (x - y) ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have := Filter.Tendsto.const_mul ((x - y) ^ 2) h_geom
      simpa using this
    exact ge_of_tendsto h_mul (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun k => h_le k x y))
  refine ⟨f 0, funext fun x => ?_⟩
  have h : |f x - f 0| = 0 := le_antisymm (h_abs x 0) (abs_nonneg _)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp h)

          norm_num
        have hzy : |z - y| = |x - y| / 2 := by
          dsimp [z]
          rw [show (x + y) / 2 - y = (x - y) / 2 by ring, abs_div]
          norm_num

      convert hmul using 1
      · ext n

        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        congr 1
        rw [div_pow]
        field_simp
        simp
      · norm_num

      filter_upwards [] with n

    have habs : |f x - f y| = 0 :=
      le_antisymm hle (abs_nonneg _)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp habs)

theorem Pugh_exercise_3_1 {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hf : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ |x - y| ^ 2) :
  ∃ c, f = λ _x => c := by
  have hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
      |f a - f b| ≤ |a - b| ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro a b
        simpa using hf a b
    | succ n ih =>
        intro a b
        let m : ℝ := (a + b) / 2
        have ham : |a - m| = |a - b| / 2 := by
          dsimp [m]
          rw [show a - (a + b) / 2 = (a - b) / 2 by ring, abs_div]
          norm_num
        have hmb : |m - b| = |a - b| / 2 := by
          dsimp [m]
          rw [show (a + b) / 2 - b = (a - b) / 2 by ring, abs_div]
          norm_num
        calc
          |f a - f b| ≤ |f a - f m| + |f m - f b| :=
            abs_sub_le _ _ _
          _ ≤ |a - m| ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n +
                |m - b| ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n :=
            add_le_add (ih a m) (ih m b)
          _ = |a - b| ^ 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by
            rw [ham, hmb, pow_succ]
            have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≠ 0 := by positivity
            field_simp [hp] <;> ring
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        norm_num
    | succ n ih =>
        have hcast : (↑(Nat.succ n) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
          norm_num
        rw [hcast, pow_succ]
        nlinarith
  have hconst : ∀ x y : ℝ, f x = f y := by
    intro x y
    have habs : |f x - f y| = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hpos : 0 < |f x - f y| :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (abs_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hne)
      let D : ℝ := |x - y| ^ 2
      let A : ℝ := |f x - f y|
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (D / A)
      have hn_pow : D / A < (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        have hnp : (n : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
          linarith [hpow n]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hn hnp
      have hp : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
      have h₁ : D < (2 : ℝ) ^ n * A :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hpos).mp hn_pow
      have h₂ : A * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ D :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hp).mp (hbound n x y)
      dsimp [D, A] at h₁ h₂
      nlinarith
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp habs)
  refine ⟨f 0, ?_⟩
  funext x
  exact hconst x 0
